_note: Site text. Editors can change any of these in Admin > Site text without touching code. {n} and {name} are filled in automatically.
site.name: Nightmare Delegate
site.tagline: Draw your nightmare. Debate it. Then go find a human.
welcome.headline: The first thing you get is a blank sheet.
welcome.subtext: Draw the debate opponent that scares you most. We'll bring it to life. You practice one round. Then you go find a human.
welcome.under_doors: All three are the right choice.
welcome.door_paper_sub: Snap a photo when you're done.
welcome.door_sit_sub: See a round. Look at the Wall. No pressure.
definition: A nightmare is whatever's out of your comfort zone.
footer: MUN: a Multitude of Unique Nerds.
handoff.subline: The laptop is where you start, not where you stay.
handoff.lock: Your nightmare is resting for {n} more minutes. Go talk to someone 🙂
handoff.home: Home practice counts. Bring it to the next meeting.
meet.headline: Is this your nightmare? Fix anything that's off.
befriended: You befriended {name}. It's officially not scary anymore.
next_nightmare: Nightmares change. Once you beat one, build the next.
ritual.p1: When someone walks into our MUN room today, they don't scan for suits. The first thing they get is a blank sheet.
ritual.p2: The screen never changed. We did.
ritual.p3: We started out chasing resolutions, but we ended up finding reassurance in each other.
ritual.p4: We went from matching blazers to becoming trailblazers together.
about.p1: Show up as strangers. Leave like you always belonged.
about.p2: One person's nightmare becomes the reason someone else gets better.
practice.tip: Stop preparing what to say. Start training how to say it.
dress.p1: Intimidation doesn't have a dress code. Conferences do.
dress.p2: A suit isn't armor. Leadership doesn't need a tailored jacket.
error.camera: Your camera is shy. Click the camera icon in the address bar and choose Allow — or upload a photo instead.
error.vision_fallback: I squinted and still couldn't read it. Tell me about your drawing in one sentence?
error.not_a_drawing: Hmm, that doesn't look like a drawing of a delegate. Try another photo?
error.unsafe: Let's keep the Wall friendly for everyone. Want to try another drawing?
error.real_person: This might be a real person, so I made an original character inspired by the vibe. Rename it anytime.
error.ai_busy: The nightmare factory is packed. Switching to the backup generator…
error.ai_down: Both nightmare factories are on break. Try again in a minute — or start a Human Round. Humans never time out.
error.rate_limited: Whoa, speedy. Take a breath — try again in {n} minutes.
error.generic: Oops — something tripped over its own placard. Try again?
error.not_found: This page wandered out of committee. Let's get you back.
error.login_needed: Join the club (or log in) to do that. It takes 20 seconds.
error.big_file: That photo is too big (over 15 MB). Try a smaller one, or take a new photo.
error.bad_image: That file doesn't look like a photo we can read. Try a JPG or PNG.
error.guest_ai_off: Bringing drawings to life uses the club's AI, so it's for club members. Join with the club code — it takes 20 seconds.
wall.empty: The Wall is empty. Be the first nightmare.
demo.ribbon: Demo mode — the AI is pretend.
draw.loading_2: Teaching it to raise a placard…
draw.loading_5: Giving it a weakness (every nightmare has one)…
draw.guest_saved: Saved on this device only. Join the club to keep it on any Chromebook.
round.leave: Leave this round? It won't count.
blank.headline: Nightmares change. Once you beat one, build the next.
suggest.thanks: Thank you! An editor will read it.
